headline: Nifty rose a ninth day as *DIIs leaned against FIIs*
subline: FIIs added Rs 12,563.33 Cr in cash. DIIs pulled out Rs 8,434.53 Cr.
hero_text: FIIs bought Rs 12,563.33 Cr in cash while DIIs sold Rs 8,434.53 Cr. Foreign money won and the Nifty closed at 25,255.05.

why.title: Foreign cash outweighed DIIs
why.desc: FIIs net bought Rs 12,563.33 Cr while DIIs net sold Rs 8,434.53 Cr.

why.title: M&M lifted the auto index
why.desc: Nifty Auto rose 2.14% as M&M led the Nifty 50 higher.

why.title: State lenders led the board
why.desc: Nifty PSU Bank gained 2.94%, well ahead of Nifty Bank at 1.76%.

why.title: Participation ran wide
why.desc: 1,969 stocks advanced against 756 decliners across the market.

sector_reasons.PSU Bank: State lenders led the whole board
sector_reasons.Bank: PSU and private lenders both bid
sector_reasons.Realty: Slipped while the wider market rose

bonus_text: 1,969 stocks advanced and 756 declined. 37 of the Nifty 50 rose, 13 fell.
movers_note_gainers: M&M led at 5.30%. IndiGo and Trent followed.
movers_note_losers: Losses stayed mild. Adani Ports fell most at 1.84%.
watch_text: UK GDP at 16:30 IST and US jobless claims at 23:00 IST set Thursday's global cues. Nifty zones: 24,500 to 26,000.
lessons: State lenders outran private banks. PSU Bank gained over twice what Private Bank did.
Smallcaps beat midcaps. The Smallcap 100 rose about twice as much as the Midcap 100.
Oil rose and stocks still climbed. Brent gained 3.51% and the Nifty held its run.
Calls outweighed puts in open interest. PCR sat at 0.77 after a nine day run.
alert_text: UK GDP prints at 16:30 IST on Thursday. US jobless claims follow at 23:00 IST.
cta_headline: A wide up day. *Save it for Thursday*.
cta_sub: Next bell is Thursday 12 November, with UK GDP and US claims due.
next_text: Thursday 12 November opens after a nine day run. The Nifty weekly expiry lands Tuesday 17 November.
caption_a:
FIIs bought Rs 12,563.33 Cr of cash stocks while DIIs sold Rs 8,434.53 Cr. The Nifty still rose a ninth straight day.
It closed at 25,255.05, up 0.84%. Breadth ran 1,969 to 756.
Watch: UK GDP and US jobless claims drive Thursday's global cues.

Nifty closed at 25,255.05. India VIX ended at 17.56.
